sections.content: Use *cuando* to connect a completed past action with the moment when another action happened. The pretérito indefinido describes finished events: Cuando *llegamos*, *recibimos* los *guantes*. The connector cuando can come at the beginning or in the middle of the sentence.

items.english: When we arrived, we received the gloves.

items.spanish: Cuando terminó la actividad, volvimos a casa.
items.english: When the activity ended, we went home.
We received the gloves when we arrived.

items.spanish: Cuando empezó la mañana, trabajamos juntos.
items.english: When the morning began, we worked together.

sections.content: When *cuando* opens the sentence, put a comma after the clause it introduces: *Cuando llegamos, recibimos los guantes*. Move *cuando* to the middle of the sentence and the comma disappears.
